close_reason: Docstring on max_sse_frame now explicitly notes the 2x memory peak (raw_buf + decoded buf tracked independently) so a caller tuning for a tight budget plans for the worst case. No code change.
description: src/client.rs:496-524 — both raw_buf (incoming bytes pre-UTF-8-decode) and buf (decoded text) are checked against `sse_frame_limit`. In the worst case, the actual memory in flight is approximately 2× the configured limit (raw_buf at limit + buf decoded but not yet drained). The doc on ClientConfig::max_sse_frame says "raw bytes and decoded text" but doesn't clarify they are tracked independently. Caller setting max_sse_frame=1 MiB may see up to ~2 MiB of allocator residency. Document or change to a single combined cap.
title: subscribe_events buffer cap doc says 'limit' but raw_buf and decoded buf are checked separately
